physics.shutter: 360 deg (full frame interval, centered on the frame time)
physics.blur_method: in-composition accumulation: 80 sub-frame copies at opacity 1/80 composited with mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter over black = exact arithmetic mean (box filter). blade fill 240/255 so 240/80 = 3.0 exactly per 8-bit channel

A/B: crisp rig rises, blurred twin slides in below. Same speed throughout: 16.67 -> 10 (money shot: A dead still, B a spinning disc) -> down to 3.5 where both agree
